'''Prentioch's Dominion''' was an [[Warlord/Legends|Imperial Warlord]] faction that was established by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].

==Astrography==
Prentioch's Dominion contained Prentioch's initial sector : the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]] and systems in neighboring sectors, particularly [[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal sector]].
*[[Irnaj sector/Legends|Irnaj sector]]
*[[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]]
*[[Wornal sector/Legends|Wornal sector]]
